C1362.title: Case Study of the Warp Finance Flash Loan Attack
C1362.summary: In December 2022, researchers published an online study using the Warp Finance exploit as a case study and proposed the Flash Loan Attack Analysis (FAA) framework from its data. The framework breaks down attack steps, asset changes, and damage models in DeFi systems, helping security practitioners understand the effects of flash loan attacks and assess preventive measures for similar incidents.

references.title: The Flash Loan Attack Analysis (FAA) Framework—A Case Study of the Warp Finance Exploitation - ProQuest
